name: Reply.io
desc: Sales engagement platform for contacts, campaigns, and outbound outreach workflows.

actions.name: get_contact
actions.description: Look up a contact in Reply.io by their email address and retrieve their details.

actions.name: create_or_update_contact
actions.description: Add a new contact to Reply.io, or update their details if a contact with that email already exists.

actions.name: delete_contact
actions.description: Permanently delete a contact from Reply.io by their email address. This cannot be undone.

actions.name: create_and_push_to_campaign
actions.description: Create a new contact (or update an existing one) and immediately enrol them in a campaign so they start receiving outreach emails.

actions.name: push_to_campaign
actions.description: Enrol an existing contact in a campaign so they start receiving outreach emails. Enable "Force Push" to move the contact even if they are already active in another campaign.

actions.name: remove_from_campaign
actions.description: Stop a contact from receiving further emails in a specific campaign. The contact's record is kept in Reply.io.

actions.name: remove_from_all_campaigns
actions.description: Remove a contact from every campaign they are enrolled in. No further emails will be sent to them. Their contact record is kept in Reply.io.

actions.name: mark_replied
actions.description: Record that a contact has replied to your outreach. This stops further follow-up emails to that contact across all active campaigns.

actions.name: mark_finished
actions.description: Mark a contact as finished so they no longer receive emails in any campaign. Use this when you have completed all outreach to that contact.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
